Callout.Name: Disorientated Individual
Callout.Message: Person wandering in the road, disorientated.
Callout.Advisory: No weapon seen, person cannot say where they live.

Script.Line: He has been walking in the road for twenty minutes.
I asked him if he was all right and he did not answer me.
He is not drunk. I have seen drunk and this is not that.

Lines.Approach: They are in the road and they do not know where they are. Could be medical, could be drink.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
